text: The most amiable and most useful disposition in a young mind is diffidence of itself; and this should lead you to seek advice and instruction from him who is your natural guardian and will always counsel and direct you in the best manner, both for your present and future happiness.
author: Abigail Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 232, Abigail Adams to John Quincy Adams
